narrative.overview:
GitShowcase fuses an authentic editorial broadsheet newspaper with an engineer's tactile workbench. Built specifically for Isabela State University - Cauayan Campus computing students, the visual language departs sharply from generic flat SaaS cards and sterile dark-mode consoles. It treats repositories, capstones, and commit activity as published dispatches in an academic gazette.

Every container, button, badge, and input feels hand-drafted on warm parchment sheets with dark inked outlines, asymmetric organic radii, and crisp drop-shadow offsets that evoke ink stamped onto newsprint.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Parchment Foundation: Warm newsprint backgrounds (#F7F3E9) layered over crisp paper sheets (#FEFCF6) and card stock (#FAF6EC).
Organic Hand-Drawn Outlines: Authentic PaperCSS bounding curves (255px 15px 225px 15px/15px 225px 15px 255px) with inked 2px solid #212121 strokes.
Editorial Broadside Hierarchy: Bold condensed newsprint headings paired with casual hand-drawn body notes and monospace telemetry data.
Mechanical Drop Shadows: Zero blurred gaussian drop-shadows; all depth is rendered through hard-edged inked offsets (4px 4px 0px #000).

rules.name: The Inked Boundary Rule
rules.body: Every surface, input, button, and badge must have a visible inked border (2px solid #212121 or 1.5px solid #212121). Borderless floating cards are prohibited.

rules.name: The Warm Parchment Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#FFFFFF) is reserved solely for input box interiors; all background surfaces must use warm parchment (#FEFCF6, #FAF6EC, #F7F3E9).

rules.name: The Editorial Masthead Rule
rules.body: All major headings (h1, h2, h3) must use uppercase condensed lettering with negative letter-spacing (-0.01em to 0.02em) to mimic printed headlines.

rules.name: The 50-Character Bio Constraint Rule
rules.body: Student bio sections must strictly enforce a 50-character limit to preserve punchy newspaper card density.

rules.name: The Hard-Edge Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never use blur radii on box shadows. All shadows must be offset hard-edge blocks (Xpx Ypx 0px #212121 or rgba(0,0,0,0.85)).

dos: Do wrap every card, modal, and interactive surface with .paper-card or .paper-sheet and a 2px solid #212121 border.
Do use hard-edge drop shadows (Xpx Ypx 0px #212121) for all interactive and elevated elements.
Do use dashed dividers (border-b-2 border-dashed border-[#212121]) between article sections and cards.
Do format dates and headlines in classic broadsheet style ("WEDNESDAY, 26TH AUGUST 2026", uppercase headings).
donts: Don't use standard Tailwind geometric rounded corners (e.g. rounded-xl, rounded-2xl) without the PaperCSS asymmetric radius.
Don't use soft gaussian blurred drop shadows (shadow-md, shadow-xl) or backdrop glassmorphism.
Don't use cold pure white backgrounds (#FFFFFF) for page-level or card backgrounds; stick to warm parchment (#FEFCF6, #FAF6EC, #F7F3E9).
Don't allow long multi-line biographies on student profile cards; keep the 50-character limit intact.
